### New
- **Several entities on one line.** In simple mode, **Add an entity** shows up to five entities side by side in the same app, like `UP 750 DN 30`. Each one keeps its own label, decimals, unit and color (fixed, by steps or along a gradient). Tabs switch between them, and you choose what goes in between. An entity with no value drops out of the line, and the app leaves the rotation only when none is left. On AWTRIX NG, the whole line takes the color of its first entity.
- **Icons stored on the clock now show in the preview.** An icon named after a file on the clock, like `smile`, used to be a black square in the editor. It now shows on the app cards, on the simulated screen and next to the icon field.

### Fixed
- **An icon given by its number shows on the clock right away.** Typing `2355` instead of `lametric:2355` looked fine in the preview, but the clock showed no icon until you uploaded the icon to it yourself. A number now means that LaMetric icon, and Awtrix Studio sends it for you. If the clock already has its own file with that name, the clock's file is still used.

Existing apps keep working as they are. There is nothing to change after updating.

### Thanks
All three changes come from your suggestions on Reddit. Thank you to [u/dyabolikarl](https://www.reddit.com/user/dyabolikarl) for the idea of several entities on one line and for reporting the icons that would not show, and to [u/Jealous_Matter3398](https://www.reddit.com/user/Jealous_Matter3398) for asking to see the clock's own icons in the preview.
